old_row.rationale: Nehemiah's prayer acknowledges God's righteousness while confessing wrongdoing; Ezra's prayer likewise calls the Lord righteous while the surviving community stands before Him in its offenses.

new_row.rationale: The prayer recorded in Nehemiah acknowledges God's righteousness while confessing wrongdoing; Ezra's prayer likewise calls the Lord righteous while the surviving community stands before Him in its offenses.
